INTRODUCTION
Welcome to Acrux Dynamics Pvt. Ltd. We are delighted to have you as part of our team and hope that your
journey here will be rewarding, fulfilling, and full of growth.
Acrux Dynamics is a product-based software company headquartered in HITEC City, Hyderabad. Founded in
2014 by Lamine Yamal and Aitana Bonmati, we have grown from a 12-person startup to over 4,500 employees
across India, the Middle East, and North America. Our flagship products, AcruxHR, AcruxCRM, AcruxInsight, and
AcruxDesk, are trusted by enterprise clients across the United States, the United Kingdom, the Middle East, and
Southeast Asia.
This Employee Handbook is your first point of reference for understanding the policies, practices, and culture at
Acrux Dynamics. Please read it thoroughly and keep it handy. For any queries, the HR team is always available
to assist you.
SCOPE AND APPLICABILITY
This handbook applies to all employees of Acrux Dynamics Pvt. Ltd., including full-time permanent employees,
employees serving their probation period, fixed-term contract employees, and interns or trainees. Consultants
and third-party contractors engaged through vendor agreements are governed by their respective service
contracts and are not covered under this handbook unless specifically mentioned.

MISSION, VISION AND VALUES
Our Mission
To build intelligent software that empowers organisations to work smarter, move faster, and grow sustainably.
Our Vision
To become the most trusted enterprise SaaS platform used by 10,000 organisations across 50 countries by 2030.
Our Core Values
  Integrity: We conduct ourselves with honesty and transparency in all our dealings, internal and external.
 Excellence: We hold ourselves to high standards in every product we build and every commitment we make.
 Collaboration: We believe the best outcomes come from diverse teams working together with mutual
respect.
 Innovation: We encourage curiosity, challenge assumptions, and reward creative problem-solving.
 Empathy: We listen carefully to our customers and our colleagues and treat everyone with dignity.

WORKING HOURS AND ATTENDANCE
Acrux Dynamics follows a five-day work week, Monday through Friday. Standard working hours are 9:30 AM to
6:30 PM IST, with a 30-minute unpaid lunch break. Employees are expected to complete a minimum of nine

working hours each day.
Flexible Working Hours
Employees at grade L3 and above may opt for flexible working hours within a core band of 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM
IST, subject to written approval from their reporting manager. All approved flexible working schedules must be
documented through the AcruxHR portal.
Attendance
Attendance is recorded through biometric terminals at all office locations and through the AcruxHR mobile
application for employees working remotely. Employees must mark their entry and exit each working day without
exception. Three or more consecutive days of absent or unmarked attendance without a corresponding approved
leave entry will trigger an escalation to the HR Business Partner.
